We are not currently enrolling a 200-hour teacher training cohort. services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Teaching has always been at the heart of Yoga from the Heart. As Sarasota’s first Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga School, we have spent more than 25 years helping students and teachers deepen their understanding of yoga through thoughtful practice, anatomy, alignment, sequencing, philosophy, and mentorship. While we are not currently enrolling a new teacher training group, this work remains an important part of who we are. We welcome inquiries from students and teachers interested in future teacher training, advanced study, continuing education, or one-on-one mentorship with Lynn. services.name: Class Descriptions
services.desc: Accessible and supportive for students with foundational yoga experience, this class focuses on alignment, stability, core strength, and mindful movement. You’ll explore poses in a way that helps you better understand your body and build confidence in your practice. This beginner-friendly class teaches the foundational poses and movement principles that support flexibility, strength, and ease of movement on and off the mat. We often begin with gentle somatic movement to release tension and improve body awareness before moving into attainable yoga postures. services.name: Treatment Room Rentals
services.desc: Yoga from the Heart is home to independent massage and healing practitioners who rent treatment space within the studio. Treatment rooms may be available to rent or share depending on current availability. If you are a licensed massage therapist, bodyworker, or aligned healing professional interested in possible room-sharing or rental opportunities, please contact the current practitioner whose work seems most aligned with yours. If you are unable to connect with a current practitioner or have additional questions, please email Yoga from the Heart with your name, credentials, type of work, preferred schedule, and contact information.
